purpose: Complete the official or primary-public locator layer for every source route declared by the fourteen macro-estate fan-out lanes without claiming that the underlying record universe has been acquired.
interpretation_boundary: A complete locator registry is not a complete source corpus. A portal, API, collection, archive, or request route proves only where bounded records can be sought.

routes.bounded_output: Company numbers, officers, PSCs, filing history, charges, insolvency, and document identifiers.
routes.residual_fog: Filed information may be inaccurate; document images, historical names, foreign entities, and legal-identity adjudication require further checks.

routes.authority: UK Cabinet Office / Crown Commercial Service
routes.bounded_output: UK below-threshold notices and awards, OCDS releases, supplier identifiers, values, dates, and attachments.
routes.residual_fog: Signed contracts and attachments are notice-specific; buyer/supplier Companies House resolution and unsuccessful bids remain.

routes.authority: U.S. Department of Justice and courts
routes.bounded_output: Press releases, charging instruments, judgments, dockets, opinions, settlements, and current dispositions.
routes.residual_fog: A press release is not the docket; sealed/protected filings, appeal status, and party-specific dispositions require exact case retrieval.

routes.bounded_output: Daily contract announcements with awardee, amount, competition, appropriation, and contracting activity.
routes.residual_fog: Announcements are not complete award files and do not establish obligations, outlays, evaluations, or acceptance.

routes.bounded_output: Candidate, committee, report, contribution, disbursement, and filing-image identifiers.
routes.residual_fog: Committee affiliation, recipient identity, refunds, memo entries, and full neutral-cohort nulls remain estate-specific.

routes.bounded_output: Legacy and current contract-award records keyed by PIID and modification.
routes.residual_fog: Legacy FPDS/SAM reconciliation and archived modification history remain to be normalized.

routes.authority: Office of the Federal Register / GPO
routes.bounded_output: Rules, notices, presidential documents, agency identifiers, dates, docket numbers, and document numbers.
routes.residual_fog: A notice is not the underlying adjudication, approval, meeting attendance, or contract transaction.

routes.bounded_output: UK procurement notices and OCDS release packages keyed by notice ID and OCID.
routes.residual_fog: Notice publication is not performance, outlay, acceptance, or proof of all bids and evaluation records.

routes.bounded_output: Bid-protest docket, outcome, decision, solicitation, agency, and public decision documents.
routes.residual_fog: Routine dismissals and protected filings are not always public; FOIA may be required for decided-case records.

routes.bounded_output: Official publications, announcements, transparency data, collections, organisations, and content identifiers.
routes.residual_fog: Search results do not by themselves freeze implementation, supplier, appointment, or decision denominators.

routes.bounded_output: Property, lease, procurement, travel, and agency records with stable identifiers where published.
routes.residual_fog: Lease schedules, property-level payments, and protective-service records may require targeted requests or agency records.

routes.authority: Office of the Clerk, U.S. House of Representatives
routes.bounded_output: House member/candidate financial disclosure and periodic-transaction filing metadata and PDFs.
routes.residual_fog: PDF extraction, amendments, occupied-office denominators, and explicit member-level nulls require a frozen acquisition window.

routes.bounded_output: Offshore entity, officer, intermediary, address, and relationship tables with source-dataset identifiers.
routes.residual_fog: Leak inclusion does not validate legal identity, beneficial ownership, transaction activity, or current status; official registries are required.

routes.bounded_output: LEI reference data, legal names, registration authorities, parent relationships, and mapped identifiers.
routes.residual_fog: LEI coverage is incomplete for many private entities; non-LEI entities still require official registries.

routes.authority: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration
routes.bounded_output: Archival descriptions, record groups, series, file units, digital objects, and stable NAIDs.
routes.residual_fog: Catalog description does not imply digitization; record requests and box/folder retrieval may remain necessary.

routes.authority: NATO Defence Innovation Accelerator for the North Atlantic
routes.bounded_output: Challenge cohorts, company names, countries, challenge areas, phase progression, test centres, and contractual funding statements.
routes.residual_fog: Legal-company identifiers, unsuccessful applicants, founders, investors, and national awards require external registry joins.

routes.authority: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control
routes.bounded_output: Sanctions-list identifiers, programs, aliases, entity types, dates, and list changes.
routes.residual_fog: Name similarity is insufficient; official IDs, dates, program scope, removals, and ownership rules must be resolved.

routes.authority: U.S. Office of Government Ethics and agency ethics offices
routes.bounded_output: Public financial disclosures, PTRs, ethics agreements, certifications, recusals, waivers, and divestiture certificates.
routes.residual_fog: OGE holds only part of the filer universe; agency-by-agency requests, six-year retention limits, and lawful-use attestations remain.

routes.bounded_output: Presidential nominations and appointments plus agency appointment announcements.
routes.residual_fog: Announcements are not a complete office-defined cohort; confirmations, commissions, acting service, departures, and agency records must be joined.

routes.bounded_output: Agency-specific award instruments, modifications, milestone records, and public decision files.
routes.residual_fog: There is no universal public repository for complete award files; each program and contracting activity must be partitioned.

routes.bounded_output: National procurement, grant, innovation, and defence-award records for the frozen cohort.
